text:
jordan: Quick follow-up on the BurstSieve canary we flipped overnight — summary first: long-sequence p99 down ~25%, p95 down ~12%, p50 ~flat. Token cost for long-chat flows dropped ~9%.

priya: huge! what's BurstSieve doing differently vs previous packer?

jordan: two main changes: 1) active KV de-dup window that collapses redundant KV loads across concurrent streams; 2) sequence-aware batcher that greedily groups long-continuation requests with a small backoff to avoid tiny single-row GPU invocations. Together they cut redundant memory work and increase useful batch sizes.

tom: any observed regression for short single-turn API calls?

jordan: minimal. p50 unchanged, a slight +3ms for very short calls under extreme low-load, but p95 improves overall because queueing variability drops. We consider it a net improvement.

emily: errors or OOM chatter on canary nodes?
jordan: noticed two transient OOM warnings in canary-9 during a spike; increased per-pod mem limit by 5% and that cleared. No customer-visible errors.

infra-bot: deploy-bot reports: BurstSieve v1.0 -> canary cluster (canary-9) SUCCESS at 2024-11-02T03:41:29Z

priya: config so infra can replicate?
jordan: paste: 

```
batch_strategy: seq-aware
dedup_kv_window_ms: 12
backoff_ms: 8
max_group_seq_len: 4096
prefetch_on_detect: true
```

tom: where are the bench dashboards and diff graphs?
jordan: put the dashboards here: https://internal.redwood/dashboard/burstsieve/canary-9 — key panels: batch size distribution, kv-dup-rate, p95/p99 vs baseline, cost-by-route. Snapshot numbers: long-chat token cost -9.1%, p99 -25.3% (sample: conversations+summaries), batch_size median +1.8x.

emily: what's rollout plan + rollback criteria?
jordan: rollout: start 10% eu-west, watch 72h. then 30% -> 60% if green. Auto-rollback on: p99 regresses >7% absolute vs baseline or error rate >0.4% sustained for 10m.

priya: did we add telemetry for KV dedup events? would help correlate savings per-customer.
jordan: yes — I added span tags and metric counters. PR #4279 adds kv_dedup_count, dedup_rate, group_size_hist. Landing now.

tom: can SRE add a synthetic that mixes long streams + small bursts to catch regressions?
emily: created perf-synth/burstsieve-stress (runs every hour) and a weekly soak across all regions.

deploy-bot: Canary -> eu-west-1 flip (10%) scheduled by jordan for 2024-11-04T01:00:00Z

priya: any docs or console flag changes?
jordan: Console will expose a toggle behind "BurstSieve (experimental)" for Hosted customers. We'll keep Private defaults off for now and provide upgrade notes. I'll add a short blurb to #announcements later today.

emily: please add a short entry to the release-notes with the bench numbers and the mem-limit tweak so operators know.

jordan: done — added release-note draft and the mem-limit note.

priya: excellent work team :rocket: let's keep an eye on the long-tail metrics next 72h.
jordan: will post a canary wrap after the eu-west run and attach the dashboard slices. Thanks everyone.
